description: Routing heuristics compete on identical warehouse tasks. A challenger becomes champion only after measured improvement. This is a new deterministic seeded instance of the existing invention-league environment, with its own starting world and a 12-decision campaign. Campaign completion records the end of observation, without claiming the goal was achieved. Goal: Within a 12-decision campaign, find a routing heuristic with fewer total training steps than the seeded column-order baseline and no increase in withheld steps; preserve actual shortest-path replays as evidence.
goal: Within a 12-decision campaign, find a routing heuristic with fewer total training steps than the seeded column-order baseline and no increase in withheld steps; preserve actual shortest-path replays as evidence.

facts: A robot must visit every pick location and return to the depot; obstacles are impassable.
All path legs use exact shortest paths on the same four-neighbor grid.
Candidate heuristics choose the visit order; lower total walking distance is better.
Four fixed training fixtures and three fixed withheld fixtures evaluate every challenger.
Promotion requires fewer training steps and no regression on the withheld fixtures.
Replays show actual training paths. Held-out locations remain private.
